errors.notReassignable: The task is not available for reassignment.
errors.queuedNotEditable: This queued message is no longer editable.
errors.alreadyAnswered: This question has already been answered or closed.
errors.submitThroughCard: Submit the answer through the saved question card.
errors.missingTurnIdentity: This runtime request is missing the provider turn identity needed to resolve it.
errors.permissionNoForm: This runtime permission does not accept submitted form data.
errors.dismissFailed: Unable to dismiss this request. Try again.

waiting.label: Waiting to resume
waiting.detail: The previous execution needs to be checked before work can continue. See the task’s execution hold for the next action. Individual checks remain in the run history.

failure.runtimeMissing: The selected provider runtime is missing a required package. Reinstall or rebuild Paperclip with its bundled provider dependencies, restart the server, then test the agent's runtime before retrying.
failure.approvalRequired: This operation requires approval, but this runner has no interactive approval handler. Review the operation and update the agent's permission setting before retrying.
failure.selectedModelRejected: The provider rejected the selected model.
failure.chooseModel: Choose a supported model or clear the task's model override, then retry.
failure.swarmNotStarted: Swarm did not start, and nothing was changed. Send /swarm again to try once more.
failure.usageLimit: The model provider has reached its current usage limit. Try again after the limit resets.
failure.diskFull: The agent filled the disk of its computer, so the run stopped. Ask the agent to use less disk space, then retry.
failure.frameTooLarge: Provider output exceeded the safe limit.
failure.repairBranch: Repair the starting branch below before retrying.
failure.useConnectionCard: Use the connection card below to continue.
failure.aiUnavailable: This run stopped because its AI account was unavailable.
failure.reconciliation: The previous execution must be checked before this task can continue. Your message is preserved. View the stopped run for details.
failure.workspaceSetup: Workspace setup failed before the agent started.

retry.canRetry: You can retry this message now.

terminal.noResponse: The runner returned no user-facing response.
terminal.turnCancelled: This turn was cancelled before it returned a response.

history.error: Some task history could not be loaded.
history.loading: Some task history is still loading.

stoppedBeforeResponse: This run stopped before a response was available. Review the task’s connection or recovery action below.
